verified_development: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 (18 Nov) and began trading on Nasdaq on 19 Nov 2026, opening at $111.50 (about +34%).
disclosure: Disclosure: this package was written by Claude, an Anthropic model. The script reports only verified figures, makes no investment claim, and ends on an open question rather than a view.
research_summary: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, priced its IPO at $83 a share on 18 November 2026, above the $70-78 range it set on 10 November, selling 980 million Class A shares (about $81.3 billion at the offer price). Trading began on Nasdaq on 19 November under the ticker ANT. Nasdaq reported an opening price of $111.50, about 34% above the IPO price. News outlets report a first-day close of $97.17 (+17%), but no primary record of the close was found, so the script uses the open. Market-value estimates differ by counting method, so they are not used. The writer of this package is an Anthropic model; the script sticks to verified numbers and makes no prediction about the stock.
